candidate_windows.window_text: In this section, we describe the details of our evaluation that are omitted in Section 5 due to space constraints.

To train our GNN, we use a dropout rate of 0.2, a batch size of 64, and a learning rate of 1e-5, optimized with RAdam. The model is fine-tuned on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU for approximately 3 hours. Our KG containing 799,273 nodes and 2,487,810 edges. Our $g_{e}$ is pruned based on KG to retain 200 high-ranking nodes with a hop size of 2.
